messages.subject: sum
parts:
It possible to reduce `sum(get_server_count(env, "doc1"), get_server_count(env, "doc2"))` in
```
 branch(function() 
    sum(get_server_count(env, "server1"), get_server_count(env, "server2")) ==  2, T, ....
```
to a more compact form that can handle more than 2 servers? I was thinking in using
```
sum <- function() {
my.sum = 0
for(i in docs){
  current <- get_server_count(env, i)
  # Update variable storing sum
  my.sum <- my.sum + current
} 
return(my.sum)
}
```
I do not think it's correct.
